blocks.content:
The President can grant:
• Pardon – Completely removes punishment
• Reprieve – Temporary stay
• Respite – Reduced sentence
• Remission – Shortens punishment
• Commute – Changes punishment type

items: Remember that Article 72 deals with the President's pardoning powers.
Do not confuse Remission (shortens punishment duration) with Commutation (changes the type of punishment).
Pardon is the only form that completely absolves the offender from all sentences and disqualifications.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Article 72 of the Indian Constitution details the Pardoning Power of the President.
A Pardon completely removes both the sentence and the conviction of an offender.
Reprieve implies a temporary stay of the execution of a sentence.
Respite results in awarding a reduced sentence instead of the one originally prescribed.
Remission shortens the duration of punishment without changing its character, while Commute changes the punishment type to a lighter form.
